messages:
sam: Noticed intermittent p95 spikes on engine 3.2.3-rc after scheduler reorder landed. Seen on two canary hosts during mixed batch traffic.

nina: Which scheduler change? The reorder we added to favor MatMul locality?

sam: yes, commit ad3c9f2. Logs show matmul stalls when bursty multi-request arrives. Short snippet: `sched: dispatch delay=120ms for matmul_v2`

omar: thermal looks fine. I ran a quick local repro with `--force-concurrent` and reproduced p95 increase ~2x.

perfbot: perf summary attached: p95 baseline 320ms -> rc 640ms under concurrent load. Tokens/s -12%.

nina: recommendation: pin canaries to engine:3.2.2 and open revert PR for ad3c9f2. We should avoid touching staging yet.

sam: agree. Can we do a sticky pin just for the canary pool?

deploy-bot: @nina requested: apply sticky pin on canary-pool -> engine:3.2.2. Command: `/deploy pin canary-pool engine:3.2.2 --sticky-ttl 6h`
deploy-bot: Pin applied ✅ (canary-pool -> engine:3.2.2) by nina at 2026-03-28T05:12Z

ci-bot: created branch revert/ad3c9f2 and started quick-qbuild: `/ci build --profile quick revert/ad3c9f2`

omar: also add temporary telemetry for dispatch latency and queue depth on canary hosts.

sre-oncall: noted. Increased stats retention for canary cluster for 2h. Alert rule added: if dispatch-delay > 100ms for 10m, notify #eng-runtime oncall.

perfbot: quick-qbuild artifacts uploaded. Running smoke on pinned canary pool now.

ci-bot: quick-qbuild smoke failed on one synthetic probe due to unrelated image pull flake. Ignoring if other metrics look good.

perfbot: smoke (revert build) shows p95 back to 330ms over 40m window; tokens/s within 3% of baseline.

nina: plan: merge revert, keep canaries pinned, schedule 3% controlled slice overnight with extra dispatch telemetry. If green, ramp to 15% next window. Ops/QA to approve unpin.

sam: adding note to release notes: KNOWN_ISSUE -> schedule-reorder causing dispatch delays under concurrent mix. Mitigation: canary pin to 3.2.2; revert merged.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to unpin canary-pool after validation use `/deploy unpin canary-pool` (ops approval required).

sre-oncall: I'll keep the alert quiet window aligned with the trial slice.

omar: merging revert now. Kicking follow-up build and will post results in thread.

perfbot: follow-up build green. Recommend A/B slice for 30m then ramp.

sam: thanks all — keeping thread open until night slice completes. Reopen if any regressions crop up.
